specific_diseases_listed: 90 days for 3 lifestyle conditions (Hypertension, Diabetes, Cardiac)
2 years for 19 procedures (Cataract, Hernia, Hydrocele, Piles, etc.)
3 years for 4 (Joint replacement, Osteoarthritis, Morbid Obesity, Stem Cell)
sub_limits_waiting_notes: 3 plans (A/B/C). Plan A: Rs 2-10L. Plan B: Rs 15/20/25L. Plan C: Rs 30/40/50L. Maternity sub-limits scale with plan. Higher plans cover air ambulance / medical reunion.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Plan A: 1% SI room / 2% SI ICU; Plan B: Up to Rs 15,000 room or actuals; Plan C: Up to Rs 20,000 room or actuals
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Covers room/ICU, doctors, surgery, drugs, OT, prosthetics.

maternity_coverage.limit_text: Plan A: Rs 30K normal / Rs 50K caesarean. Plan B: Rs 60K / 75K. Plan C: Rs 80K / 100K.

newborn_coverage.limit_text: Newborn covered up to 3 months under maternity / mother's SI

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Plan A: Rs 2,500 / Plan B: Rs 4,000 / Plan C: Rs 5,000 per policy year

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Optional Cover: Rs 2/3/5/10/15/20/25 Lakh benefit per individual on diagnosis of CI

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: End of every 2-year block (if renewed without break)

room_rent_capping: Plan A: 1% SI/day; Plan B: Rs 15,000/day or actual; Plan C: Rs 20,000/day or actual
icu_capping: Plan A: 2% SI/day; Plan B/C: actual
copayment_trigger_notes: Optional 10% or 20% co-pay for 12.5% or 25% premium discount.

disease_wise_sub_limits.cataract: Plan A: 15% SI or Rs 60,000/eye (lower). Plan B: Rs 80,000/eye. Plan C: Rs 1,00,000/eye.
disease_wise_sub_limits.hospital_cash: Plan A: Rs 500 / Plan B: Rs 800 / Plan C: Rs 1,000 per day, max 5 days
disease_wise_sub_limits.air_ambulance: Plan B/C: 5% of SI per policy year
disease_wise_sub_limits.medical_emergency_reunion: Plan B/C: Rs 20,000 per policy year
disease_wise_sub_limits.doctor_home_visit: Plan B: Rs 750 / Plan C: Rs 1,000 per day, max 10 days
disease_wise_sub_limits.vaccination_children: All plans: Rs 1,000 per year (kids up to 12)

notable_exclusions_summary: Multi-plan indemnity policy (3 plans A/B/C). Higher plans add air ambulance, emergency reunion, home doctor visits. Optional CI lumpsum and OPD covers. Maternity included on indemnity basis with limits scaling by plan.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via TPA at network/PPN with 1-hour pre-auth TAT. Reimbursement within 15 days of discharge. Claim decision within 15 days; 30-day window if rejection.
